node.title: Re: Internet connection 4g modem
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [mic537],

But Strawberry Perl does not connect to internet through my 4g modem, while ActivePerl connected well.

What does this mean - are you using a Perl script to connect via a modem? Are you using any Perl modules for this, and could you show a short, runnable piece of example code that demonstrates the problem? Please see [id://174051] and [http://www.sscce.org/|Short, Self Contained, Correct Example].

Regards,
-- Hauke D
